age.evidence: Male and female C57BL/6 mice aged 8-12 weeks (Charles River, Senneville, Canada)

sex.evidence: A 3 mg kg-1 body weight psilocybin or co-crystal solution was orally administered to 3 males and 3 females for each time point, except for 10 min when only 1 male was treated with psilocybin. Fig. 4 caption: 'n = 6 per group, except for the 10 min time point in the psilocybin group, where 4 animal received psilocybin'

dosing.evidence: received either oral psilocybin or co-crystal formulation (both at a total formulation mass of 3 mg kg-1 body weight) ... the resulting powder was dissolved in a vehicle solution (Kolliphor™, 70% ethanol, PBS, in ratios of 1 : 1 : 18) in 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)

dosing.doses_raw: 3 mg kg-1 of total mass formulation
dosing.evidence: The powder was dissolved in a vehicle solution of PBS to obtain a 1 mg mL-1 solution, which was further diluted in PBS as necessary ... Oral gavage for psilocybin and co-crystal was performed with a maximum volume of 200 mL per animal.

handling.evidence: After arrival, the mice were left to acclimate for one week and were subsequently conditioned daily for 7 days to adapt to the researcher and the oral gavage procedure.

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed that there are no behavioural assays. The paper is an LC-MS/MS bioanalytical method validation paper. Its only in vivo component is destructive brain sampling for pharmacokinetics at 10 min, 1 h and 3 h after oral dosing. That is ex vivo tissue quantification, which the rubric excludes, so the assays array is empty.
The paper mentions behavioural effects only in passing ('ongoing parallel studies, which will be reported upon completion'). No behavioural data are reported here.
Age: two of three candidates gave 'young_adult' for 8-12 weeks, so the modal value was used.

Sex counts: I used qwen's n_male = 16 and n_female = 18 even though the modal candidate value was null. These are my arithmetic reconstruction rather than counts the paper states as totals, which is why confidence is medium.

How the sex counts were derived: 3 males and 3 females per time point per compound, except 1 male at 10 min for psilocybin. The Fig. 4 caption says 4 animals in that group, consistent with 3 females plus 1 male.
Psilocybin vehicle was set to 'other'. It was a Kolliphor/70% ethanol/PBS mixture (1:1:18) in 10% DMSO.
Co-crystal vehicle was set to 'PBS', as stated in the paper.
Handling was set to 'yes' because the paper explicitly describes 7 days of daily conditioning to the researcher and the gavage procedure.
